home.title: Yayatoh
home.tagline: Your events and tickets will appear here soon.

prompt.title: Get updates about your tickets?
prompt.intro: Yayatoh can send notifications to this phone about:

items.tickets: A ticket sent to you, or a transfer accepted or cancelled
items.changes: An event changing or being cancelled
items.reminders: A reminder 24 hours and 2 hours before an event starts

prompt.privacy: Notifications show the event name and what changed, never your name, email, phone number, payment amount or ticket code.
prompt.control: You can change this any time in Account, Notifications.
prompt.againLater: If you choose Not now, we will ask again only after a later purchase. You can use everything in the app either way.

settings.title: Notifications

status.undetermined: Notifications are not set up yet

statusBody.granted: You will get the updates listed below. To turn them all off, use your phone’s settings.
statusBody.denied: Notifications are off for Yayatoh. To turn them on, open your phone’s settings.
statusBody.undetermined: Turn them on to get updates about your orders, tickets and events.

settings.optional: Notifications are optional. Tickets, orders and sign-in work the same with them off.

service.title: Orders and tickets
service.body: Order confirmed, ticket received, transfer accepted or cancelled. Sent whenever notifications are on.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: 24 hours and 2 hours before an event starts.

eventChanges.title: Event changes
eventChanges.body: When an event changes or is cancelled.

settings.kindsUnavailable: Choosing which of these you get is not available yet. To stop them all, turn notifications off in your phone’s settings.
settings.saveFailed: We could not save that. Check your connection and try again.
settings.marketingBody: Off. We only send these if you choose to receive them.
